data.title: U.S. plans to name Nvidia among AI ‘national champions’, WSJ reports
data.description: Investing.com-- The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen companies, including Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA), Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT), OpenAI and Anthropic, as artificial intelligence "national champions" to help them expand overseas and compete with Chinese technology firms, the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday.
